sources.population: Bogalusa adult cross-sectional cohort: 3402 nondiabetic Black/White men/women, ages20-56, surveys1995-2016. Overlaps Sun2014; not independent cohorts.

sources.population: Bogalusa2447 adults ages19-54, surveys1988-2010; excludes treatment for hypertension/dyslipidemia/diabetes, nonfasting samples and missing study variables; overlaps Yun2021.

sources.identifier: Changes in Adipose Tissue Distribution and Association between Uric Acid and Bone Health during Menopause Transition;2019;DOI10.3390/ijms20246321;PMC6941025
sources.population: Independent Ferrara Italy sample of358 apparently healthy Caucasian women ages25-65:124 premenopausal,234 postmenopausal. Recruited from bone-densitometry clinic and university employees. Excluded diabetes, relevant medications, major chronic disease, excessive alcohol, pregnancy/breastfeeding and premenopausal osteoporosis.
sources.measurement: Fasting serum urate in micromol/L by direct uricase-peroxidase enzymatic spectrophotometry; measured anthropometry/DXA. Menopause defined from menstrual history, not age proxy. Not a calibrated assay/population bridge to the US fixed cohort.
cohort_ids: University of Ferrara menopause and osteoporosis studies
